betteti_2025.title: Input-driven dynamics for robust memory retrieval in Hopfield networks
betteti_2025.published_mechanism: Input saliency modulates the associative interaction matrix; the peer-reviewed formulation uses squared pattern-input overlap. The modern reformulation includes a source-defined input filter tau_z and gives alpha=z⊙z in the fast-filter limit.

betteti_old_github.finding: The inspected 2024 public GitHub implementation uses a linear overlap in the multiplicative interaction, not the squared saliency of the peer-reviewed paper. MainHNN_SHB.py uses dt=0.01 and stochastic trajectories without a fixed seed.
betteti_old_github.specific_code: Stimulus Driven Plasticity (SDP) Hopfield/Eul_May.py: Dalph=(1/N)*diag(mems.T@u); W=(1/N)*mems@Dalph@mems.T.
betteti_old_github.replication_note: cswin/Input-Driven-Hopfield is a passive fork of sim1bet/Input-Driven-Hopfield and is not independent reproduction evidence.

vivet_arenas_2026.title: Emergent self-attention from astrocyte-gated associative memory dynamics
vivet_arenas_2026.scaling_observation: Official fitness is f=(patterns@tanh(10x))^2/(2N). Near correct retrieval this is O(N), so a numerically fixed tau_p is not dimension-invariant: effective gain-selection speed accelerates as N rises.

prg_2026.title: Representation Transfer via Invariant Input-driven Continuous Attractors for Fast Domain Adaptation
prg_2026.mechanism: Task-agnostic synthetic pretraining shapes vanilla RNN modules into low-dimensional input-driven continuous attractor manifolds for direction, velocity and salience; lightweight downstream adapters reuse the frozen dynamics.
quantitative_transfer: DVS Gesture full modular system: 94% accuracy; spatial-only 80%, spatial+direction 88%, full refinements 94%.
Direction module alone transfers with 97% direction classification and strong frame-dropout/interpolation robustness.
RGB rehabilitation: 90% macro-class and 62% overall subclass accuracy; spatial-only 43% overall, +velocity 56.5%, full 62%.
5-shot DVS: about 70% versus ResNet-50 C3D 58% and ViViT 28%.
5-shot RGB macro-class: about 75% versus about 20% ResNet C3D and 21% ViViT.
Model about 5M parameters versus 240-300M for cited large baselines; paper reports minutes versus hours of downstream training.
prg_2026.code: Paper reports complete simulation/analysis code at Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16441066.

actions: Audited the Betteti peer-reviewed equation against the older public GitHub implementation and established a concrete provenance mismatch: squared saliency in the publication versus linear overlap in the inspected 2024 GitHub code.

Attempted to resolve the cited Betteti Zenodo artifact, but the current web/container tool path could not retrieve the Zenodo record/files. This is a retrieval limitation, not evidence that the artifact is absent.
Implemented the source-defined dynamic saliency filter z_dot=(-z+g*(Xi·u)/N)/tau_z and alpha=z^2, replacing the previous instantaneous-only source saliency in the matched hybrid tests.

Ran common-random-number matched tests in a source-valid low-component regime N=256,K=3 and the inherited high-interference regime N=30,K=100, including fixed-uniform source IDP, instantaneous softmax, generic leaky-softmax and positivity-preserving astrocyte replicator controls.
Diagnosed a transfer-scaling problem in the unnormalized astrocyte fitness: the same tau_p becomes effectively much faster at larger N because f scales with N.

Because no robust replicator-specific benefit survived in the low-component source-valid regime, deprioritized the astrocyte replicator as a direct AI-transfer mechanism pending a principled dimension-normalization rule.

Redirected the frontier to input-driven continuous-attractor transfer and added the 2026 Communications Biology PRG system because it has real DVS/RGB transfer, few-shot gains, module ablations and public code availability.

protocol.shared: iid ±1 stored patterns; phi=tanh(10x); source saliency filter z_dot=(-z+g*(Xi·u)/N)/tau_z; alpha=z^2; g=4; common-random-number matched variants; 30% exact-bit nuisance corruption; q=0.75 and true-context-switch hazard h=0.02 per 0.2-s query epoch; 1-s clean burn-in + 6-s evaluation; dt=0.02 s.
protocol.hybrid: b=(1/N) Xi^T[(alpha*Kp)⊙(Xi phi(x))]. Uniform p=1/K is source IDP; adaptive p adds the astrocyte routing degree of freedom.
protocol.gain_normalization: Additional controls rescaled alpha*Kp to preserve total source saliency, separating routing from amplitude.

source_valid_N256_K3.interpretation: No adaptive routing variant showed a statistically reliable Hamming benefit over source IDP. Apparent fast-tau gains shrink toward zero when tau_p is increased enough to compensate the O(N) fitness scale.

high_interference_N30_K100.interpretation: The source-defined input filter did not uncover a replicator-specific benefit in the high-interference regime either.

routing_diagnostics_tau_z_0.2.finding: Very different p concentration can yield nearly the same retrieval loss. This strengthens the specificity negative: source saliency dominates the direct hybrid and the astrocyte routing state is not reliably performance-causal in these tests.

decision.reason: After source-grounding the input coupling and testing both K<<N and K>N regimes, no statistically reliable replicator-specific retrieval gain survives generic/source controls. The official fitness also creates a dimension-dependent effective tau_p unless normalized.
decision.scope_guard: This does not reject the 2026 paper's analytical fixed-point/convergence results or its small associative-memory mechanism. It only downgrades direct AI-transfer priority for the tested hybrid/scaling path.

new_candidate.mechanism: Task-agnostic synthetic pretraining sculpts reusable low-dimensional input-driven continuous attractors in vanilla RNN modules; downstream tasks compose frozen primitive modules and train only lightweight readouts/adapters.
new_candidate.why_prioritized: Unlike the astrocyte proof-of-principle, this mechanism has demonstrated transfer to real event-camera and RGB action datasets, few-shot comparisons, module ablations, robustness tests and a public code artifact.
evidence: DVS full system 94%; spatial-only 80%; adding direction 88%; full salience/fine refinements 94%.
Direction representation transfers at 97% classification with robustness to frame dropout and temporal interpolation.
RGB rehabilitation: 90% macro-class, 62% overall subclass; spatial-only 43% overall, +velocity 56.5%, full 62%.
5-shot DVS about 70% versus ResNet-50 C3D 58% and ViViT 28%; 5-shot RGB macro about 75% versus about 20% and 21%.
About 5M parameters versus 240-300M cited large baselines; minutes rather than hours of downstream training.
scope: The attractor modules are pretrained on designed synthetic motion primitives; this is engineered task-agnostic curriculum, not evidence that cortical attractors are the unique cause.
Downstream adapters/readouts are supervised, so this is not zero-shot autonomous continual learning.
Need source-code audit and independent reproduction; parameter/training comparisons must be checked for matched preprocessing and compute.
